entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I think I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so lost with it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you please provide your order number? And just to be clear, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
The order number is VF789-012. It's not broken, I don't think. It just feels very **hard to use**. I feel a bit overwhelmed, honestly.
I see, thank you for clarifying that. What specifically about it is giving you trouble?

Everything? The whole interface is so **confusing**. I read the **user manual**, and I really tried, but I guess I just **expected more** from it, you know? Something more intuitive. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.

Of course, I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. Okay, I see here you received the item 15 days ago on December 29th. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried it would be a problem.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box and drop it off at any designated shipping center.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
